messages:
Mira: Hey team — seeing a short spike of 5xxs that looks isolated to tenant_id=acct_42. Can't find a per-tenant breakdown in the usual place. Where's best for metrics/logs/traces? Also should we bump alert debounce for low-volume tenants?
Anya: Console has a tenant-slice view: Console > Observability > Error slices. Quick link (prod): https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/error-slices?env=prod. If that times out, use Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/tenant-errors. Example PromQL I run: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{env=\"prod\",status=~\"5..\",tenant_id=\"acct_42\"}[5m])) by (tenant_id)`
Juan: Logs -> Logs Explorer. Filter: `tenant_id:acct_42 AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599]`. In Kibana/ELK exact: `tenant_id:\"acct_42\" AND http.status_code >= 500`\. For traces search Tempo/Jaeger: `attribute.tenant_id:acct_42 AND span.status_code >= 500` and sort by start_time desc.
Sam: If you have a request id, quick trace lookup via our tracing service: ```curl -H 'x-request-id: <REQ_ID>' 'https://tracing.redwood.internal/lookup?request_id=<REQ_ID>'``` will return a link to the span.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Alert fired: `prod.5xx.rate` at 2024-03-21T12:05Z for route `/v1/generate` (threshold=0.5% over 5m).
Mira: Thanks — the per-tenant panel shows only a couple of errors but it's noisy for small tenants. Suggestion: for tenant slices <100 r/min, require 2 consecutive 5m windows (debounce 10m) or use absolute count >10 in 10m instead of % rate. Safer for low volume.
Eli: Agreed. Proposal: split policy into two rules: (1) high-volume: rate >0.5% over 5m; (2) low-volume tenant-slice: errors_count >= 10 over 10m. I'll draft a PR to observability rules.
Anya: When you open the PR include tenant_id in alert payload and add a direct sample-trace link. Also add runbook pointers — check the KV cache TTL and any upstream 502s (common cause).
Mira: I'll open an issue and tag @Eli and @Anya. Also can someone add a small dashboard tile that shows top-5 tenants by 5xx in last 30m? Makes quick triage easier.
Juan: On it — PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/452. Query I used: `topk(5, sum by (tenant_id) (increase(http_server_errors_total{env=\"prod\"}[30m])))` to populate the panel.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll watch the alert and gather sample request ids if it fires again. If it reappears I will paste 2-3 req ids here so someone can pull traces.
Mira: Thanks all — moving to async. Quick revisit link for triage: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/errors-by-tenant?range=30m
